title: Bolden band members: Glenny, T-Bar, Bill Harrison
summary: Picou recalls Albert Glenny as bassist and house painter, and other band members such as Bill Harrison on trombone, and later Happy Goldston at the Paddock.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
